_note: filename -> [top%, bottom%] of the FACE BAND: the top of the highest
hat or hairline to the lowest chin, as a percentage of the published
frame's height. Read by scripts/build_banners.py and published into
MEASURED OFF THE ART against the 280px band, per face:
back row, wine glass    ~0-4%   (top of head cut by the source frame)
back row, fistful of money ~0-10% (hairline at the frame edge)
right-centre, headphones ~32-57%  <- the lowest chin, and the binding one
So [0, 57]. The top is 0 because the two back-row heads are cropped by
the artwork itself, not by the masthead: their highest VISIBLE point is
the frame edge. That is what this number has to describe, since it is
what the cap has to hold.
